verdict.rationale: An official AWS Pricing Calculator is evidenced at calculator.aws, which covers the stack-estimation half of the story, but only as a bare title with no description of how it works. The pack has no evidence of public per-service pricing pages. Community complaints about pricing opacity are general skepticism, not a concrete contradiction. missing for 10: evidence of public per-service pricing pages, documentation of the calculator's multi-service stack-estimation features, independent or hands-on corroboration of pre-signup estimation

support.subject: As a founder, prices are published — public per-service pricing pages and an official calculator I can estimate a stack with before signing anything
